description: Birthday-rescan attempt. Same seed + populated wallet as S2, plus --birthday 1614 (~ days since Tari epoch 2022-01-01, late May 2026).
wallet_seed_words: doctor exist smoke swing sibling okay endless unusual tent soda wire badge happy vague monster maximum cherry quiz crash friend crunch lumber unique vintage

interpretation.expected: Spec S3 wants the wallet to scan only from birthday block to tip, not from genesis to tip. With birthday=1614, the scan should have started somewhere in the recent chain.
interpretation.observed: Wallet scanned the full 674,976 blocks (the same range as S2 with no --birthday).
interpretation.implication: Either (a) the --seed-words flag's seed-encoded birthday takes precedence over --birthday CLI flag when both are present, or (b) --birthday is interpreted as 'don't accept outputs older than this' (a filter, not a scan-range optimization). Either way: the spec's 'shorter scan from birthday' optimization is not delivered by --birthday alone.

cache_warmth_finding.observation: Across three recovery runs of the same shape:
cache_warmth_finding.lesson: blocks_per_sec varies ~85% across runs purely from OS page cache state on the base node. Per-UTXO detection cost is negligible at these scales (tens of UTXOs walked across 674k blocks). The bounty operator should measure each scenario at least 3 times and report median + spread, not single shots.
